note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref) (founder decision, 2026-11-18: every Amharic work quotes OWB). Every quotation was re-quoted verbatim from it: a whole verse where the English quotes one, otherwise the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the quoted clause.

Rows still marked self_rendered are allusions, not quotations — the Tukutendereza hymn's own words ("Lamb of God", "Your blood has cleansed me"), section headings and prose echoing "walk in the light", and a bare citation of Galatians 3:28 — so they carry no Scripture wording to re-quote.
